title: 蒼穹のレジスタンス ―星図に刻む銀翼の航路―
author: 天野 ソラ

en.title: Resistance of the Azure Sky —The Silver-Winged Route Inscribed on the Star Map—
en.premise: After the Empire's collapse, Kaito and Lira have reclaimed the free skies, but they are confronted with a mysterious phenomenon where constellations that should float in the heavens vanish one by one. Riding the rebuilt “Sky Strider,” Kaito sets out on a quest for the “Lost Star Map” that can guide the missing stars. Relying on an old navigation log hidden in a secondhand bookshop, they pierce through seas of clouds and plunge into an unknown wind that leads to the edge of the cosmos.

zh.title: 苍穹的抵抗——刻在星图上的银翼航路——
zh.premise: 帝国崩溃后，Kaito 与 Lira 夺回了自由的天空，却面对着本该漂浮在空中的星座陆续消失的神秘现象。Kaito 驾驶重新打造的“Sky Strider”，踏上寻找能够指引失落星辰的“失落星图”的旅程。凭借藏在古旧书店里的航海日志，他们冲破云海，飞向通往宇宙尽头的未知风暴。
